name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　ギロロロボ
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Giroro Robo

description.ja: ぞくぞく登場するメカVer.に“ギロロロボ”登場。
description.en: “Giroro Robo” appears in the thrilling mecha version.

description.ja: ランナーから切り離しただけで手足が可動する約45mmのギロロ伍長が付属。
description.en: Approximately 45mm Giroro Corporal whose limbs can be moved just by separating it from the Runner is included.

description.ja: ギロロ伍長は専用ソーサーに搭乗、そのまま飾れる専用台が付属。
description.en: Corporal Giroro rides on a special saucer and comes with a special stand that can be displayed as is.

description.ja: ギロロロボ左腕のミサイルポッドはハッチの開閉が可能、内部ミサイルディテール再現。
description.en: The hatch of the missile pod on Giroro Robo's left arm can be opened and closed, and the internal missile details are reproduced.
